name: Switchyard by soum91
subtitle: Your OpenWrt ASUS and TP-Link in one app
description: Runs the OpenWrt ASUS router and the TP-Link Archer from one place: live speed, devices (kick and block), ad blocking and your own blocked sites, the WARP tunnel, Wi-Fi and guest network, light schedule, drop log, diagnostics and reboot.

versions.localizedDescription: - Separate router logins per app so setting one up doesn't lock the other out (plugin v3) (e17f118)
- Router dashboard: room for extra cards (kept in step with Keystone) (8b0c1c0)
- Lights Out: OpenWrt package (luci-app-lightsout) for a router light schedule that survives reboots (2ea8dbc)

- Router plugin: stop deadlocking rpcd (iwinfo CLI instead of ubus iwinfo), POSIX-safe regexes; clearer timeout errors (73e3378)
- Router plugin: list guest firewall sections by type (27dadcd)

- Switchyard: ASUS (OpenWrt) and TP-Link control in one app, plus the router plugin (d325c5b)
- Initial commit (95755ea)
